description.value: Willow Street Cafe occupies a striking 1927 heritage building in the heart of Chemainus — originally a Masonic Lodge, later a bank — that now serves made-to-order breakfasts, homemade soups, sandwiches, wraps, and their locally famous fresh-baked scones. A spacious outdoor deck makes it a natural warm-weather stop, and the cafe also offers cold beer, private event rental, and catering services.
